attribution: Christoph Reinhart / MIT OpenCourseWare; agent paraphrases and work-package grouping
review_scope: Reviewed work decomposition, not proof of exhaustive semantic acceptance or completed design

tasks.description: Select permitted city/site, source weather and neighboring obstruction geometry; explain climate/access rationale.
tasks.blocker: City/site is a permitted design choice not yet made; georeferencing, surrounding buildings and credible climate inputs are absent.

tasks.description: Develop around 3500 m2 / 250-worker program with reception, lavatory, two seminar rooms and optional cafe.
tasks.blocker: Current gross boxes do not establish usable area, occupied-space layout, clear heights or program compliance.
tasks.acceptance: Approximate targets retain unresolved acceptance bands; inspect actual room program

tasks.description: Apply supplied reflectances, 0.85 m upward sensors at 0.5 m spacing and minimum Radiance settings; check frames, single glazing surfaces, true openings and scene fidelity.
tasks.blocker: Concept voids alone do not establish a complete Radiance scene, selected glazing/frame optical data or validated annual engine.
tasks.acceptance: Source settings plus saved scene/sensor/material and engine-purpose validation

tasks.description: Compare at least three massing variants at 40 percent WWR using annual sDA300lux[50%]; select one and explore at least three window/skylight configurations.
tasks.blocker: Native annual daylight adapter, site/weather/obstructions, complete scene and optical properties are unresolved; current runtime is blocked.
tasks.acceptance: Actual annual metric/grid/scene QA and same-model comparison; no electric-light substitute

tasks.description: Assess ASE and representative DGP viewpoints, justify interventions and repeat daylight evaluation.
tasks.blocker: Annual ASE and view-based DGP tools/site/viewpoint/sky/shading inputs are not integrated; no results exist.
tasks.acceptance: Validated annual/view analysis, source viewpoints and iteration review

tasks.description: Select actual luminaires, manufacturer IES and electrical input ratings; distinguish example illustrations from selected products.
tasks.blocker: No selected product/IES/layout; the illustrative 46 W device and example office cannot be treated as project equipment.
tasks.acceptance: Manufacturer provenance, IES units and input-power evidence

tasks.description: Place luminaires, render key views and map nighttime illuminance throughout the building; calculate whole-building LPD.
tasks.blocker: Full room layout, product photometry and native analysis/render runtime are missing; around 300/150 lux targets have no stated acceptance band.
tasks.acceptance: Source-linked illuminance/LPD, visual review and approximate-target decisions

tasks.description: Resolve the thermal checklist containing daylight metrics without silently substituting acceptance criteria.
tasks.blocker: Assignment 7 page 5 labels a thermal checklist but repeats daylight metric language; instructor/intended-criterion clarification remains unavailable.
tasks.acceptance: Preserve exact contradictory wording and document any adopted interpretation explicitly

tasks.description: Create at least one thermal zone per floor, use city-specific DOE reference constructions/usage/window settings and EPW; retain all-zone monthly heating/cooling/equipment/lighting and annual totals.
tasks.blocker: Original GH settings/workbook not found in reviewed archive; source equivalence, site/EPW, boundaries, constructions, gains/schedules/HVAC and currently blocked native engine remain unresolved.
tasks.acceptance: Saved native source settings and complete-year/end-use reconciliation; distinguish loads and electricity

tasks.description: Use the actual Assignment 6 LPD, evaluate at least two upgrade sets, save zone templates/settings and report comparable annual results.
tasks.blocker: Verified lighting baseline and thermal simulation are absent; continuous dimming is an optional evaluated upgrade, not an assumed saving.
tasks.acceptance: Same-model baseline/variant runs with retained settings and end-use/comfort review

tasks.description: Apply planar-zone/minimum 3 m floor-to-floor rules and supplied game upgrade definitions, including glazing, lighting/control and fuel/COP factors.
tasks.blocker: Full game baseline/GH equivalence, R-factor unit basis and operating model are unresolved; course factors are not manufacturer ratings.
tasks.acceptance: Source table and exact candidate settings audit; no real-product claim

tasks.description: Minimize source EUI against the same baseline under at most 50 MIT game dollars; compare iteration strategies.
tasks.blocker: Native source-EUI model, numeric game-price mapping from dollar symbols/area rules and attachment settings are unresolved; MIT game dollars are not USD.
tasks.acceptance: Actual source-EUI/fuel-factor/budget arithmetic and bounded candidate reruns

tasks.description: Retain baseline and at least four important iterations, input/output files, settings, geometry and result figures, plus a strategy narrative.
tasks.blocker: No simulation iteration archive exists; Rhino/GH-specific deliverables/equivalence remain unresolved.
tasks.acceptance: Editable file manifest, exact result/settings links and substantive iteration rationale

tasks.description: Prepare 12-minute presentation plus 3-minute Q&A, design philosophy/precedents/EUI target, site, lighting, thermal concept, comfort, adaptive perspectives/plan and conclusion.
tasks.blocker: Validated design/analysis/results and complete presentation content are absent; suggested slide counts are not hard mandatory minima.
tasks.acceptance: Rubric and narrative review; figures need north arrows, units/legends and explicit site-versus-source energy basis
